$comment: The one list of top-level `_` keys in conf.d (ADR-038 decision 2). scripts/tools/dx/sync_schema.py --update GENERATES from it: the Python constants in scripts/tools/_lib_constants.py, pkg/config/reserved_keys_gen.go, and the `_` keys of docs/schemas/tenant-config.schema.json and platform-defaults.schema.json; --check fails CI when any of them is stale. Nothing reads this file at run time. `read_by` is what each reader reads, by layer, as measured: tests/shared/test_reserved_key_probes.py writes each key into each layer and fails when a reader declared here does not change its output, or when the exporter serves a key it is not declared to read. Sub-keys (`_routing.*`, `_metadata.*`, `_custom_alerts[].*`) are not listed: the code that reads them is their list.

layers.tenant: a tenant's entry in its own tenant file
layers.platform_tenants: a tenant's entry under `tenants:` in a root `_` file (the platform's per-tenant default; the tenant file wins)
layers.profile: a profile in `_profiles.yaml` that a tenant names with `_profile`
layers.platform_top: the top level of a root conf.d `_` file

readers.policy_engine: Policy-as-Code (evaluate-policy; validate-config's policy_dsl row). Listed here for `_policies`, which it reads by name; it also reads any key a deployment's rule names as `target`, which no registry can list: a verdict must count a key a rule names as read
readers.annotation: nothing on the alert path: a note for people and tools; not measured

_silent_mode.description: Suppress notifications for some severities while alerts still fire.

_severity_dedup.description: Whether a firing critical suppresses its warning twin.

_namespaces.description: Kubernetes namespaces of the tenant, written by scaffold-tenant for N:1 tenant mapping tooling.

_metadata.description: Tenant metadata (owner, tier, runbook_url, ...) served as tenant_metadata_info.
_metadata.note: The route generator also reads it and discards it (#3043); a read that changes no output is not measured.

_profile.description: The threshold profile in `_profiles.yaml` the tenant inherits from.

_routing.description: The tenant's Alertmanager route and receiver.

_routing_profile.description: A routing profile in `_routing_profiles.yaml` the tenant's route starts from.

_custom_alerts.description: Tenant-authored alert recipes compiled into rule-pack-custom-alerts.yaml.
_custom_alerts.note: The two readers take it from different layers (#3042).

_routing_defaults.description: The route every tenant without its own `_routing` gets.

_routing_enforced.description: The platform-enforced (NOC) route rendered for every tenant.

_policies.description: Policy-as-Code rules; read from the root `_defaults.yaml` only.

_state_.description: `_state_<filter>`: turns a state filter declared under the root `state_filters:` on or off.

_routing.description: Reserved for the route generator: it reads only the `_routing` keys listed above; any other `_routing...` key is reported as an unknown routing key.

retired._routing_receiver_type: no longer read: set the receiver type as `_routing.receiver.type`
